market_analysis.market_type_reason: This market is B2B because the primary buyers are municipal fire departments, industrial facilities, governments, and commercial entities requiring specialized emergency response gear.

market_analysis.primary_reason: Manufacturer was chosen because the firefighting equipment industry is fundamentally defined by the physical fabrication of vehicles, tools, and protective gear, making the creators of these hardware products the core competitive players.
